name: Todo MD
description:
Todo MD puts a plain markdown checkbox file in the panel menu, so the list stays readable in any editor and on any device.

Tasks live in a single file — ~/todo.md by default, or any path set in the preferences.

Features:
* ## Category sections become colored tabs; each category header has a ⋮ action menu (also on right-click) offering add task, change color, rename and delete
* Check, uncheck, edit inline and delete tasks; reorder them inside their category by dragging the handle at the end of a row, or with Alt+Up / Alt+Down on a focused row; drag a whole category tab along the strip to reorder its section in the file
* Fixed menu width and a configurable maximum height; the tab bar and the list keep their scroll position
* Edits made outside the shell are picked up live by a file monitor
* Preferences: todo file path, menu width, maximum menu height, category colors

Compatibility: GNOME Shell 46, 47, 48, 49, 50 and 51, each verified by a manual regression run (Ubuntu 24.04, 24.10, 25.04, 25.10, 26.04 and CachyOS).

File access: the extension only reads and writes the markdown todo file you configure (~/todo.md by default), plus its own GSettings. No network requests, no subprocesses, no clipboard use.

Shell integration: like most panel extensions, this one builds on GNOME Shell's own internal JavaScript modules (panel menu, popup menu, drag-and-drop) and on St/Clutter — they are not a stable public API, which is why shell-version lists only the releases this code has actually been tested on.
